title: MZ plugin or script that can make it so that when you press escape, not a menu but a common event appears

posts.author: nevigovar
posts.body: Is there any plugin or script that can make it so that when you press escape, not a menu but a common event appears? I tried the plugin DK FULL INPUT but it is not compatible with one of my very necessary plugins and I need an alternative

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
RPG Maker MZ only uses plugins, not scripts.
And you don't need one for this - just use the built-in event command to Change Menu Access to off at the beginning of your game, then make a common event that checks for Escape to be pressed.
This tutorial may be helpful:
Eventing a Picture-Based Menu | The Official RPG Maker Blog
The default RPG Maker menu works well, but sometimes you want one that fits your game’s aesthetic better or offers only the important options. Eventing your own picture-based menu is a great way to make sure your menu fits your game, so let’s take a look at how to make one.
www.rpgmakerweb.com
